description:
Welcome to the Wild Atlantic Health Practitioner Programme

This programme is designed for healthcare practitioners, therapists, and clinicians who want to support patients beyond the consultation — with high-quality supplements and testing they can recommend with confidence, while earning transparent, recurring commission.

Inside this portal you’ll find guidance on how the programme works, how it can support your practice, and how to integrate Wild Atlantic Health into patient education and follow-up care.

About Our Brand & Clinical Products

Wild Atlantic Health is an Irish, science-led health brand focused on long-term health outcomes, not short-term fixes.

Our supplements and home health tests are designed to support ongoing care, monitoring, and patient adherence, rather than episodic use.

  • Vitamin D3 + K2 + A
    A synergistic formulation supporting immune, skeletal, cardiovascular, and endocrine health.
  • Ocean Pure Omega-3
    A high-strength, low-toxin omega-3 supporting cardiovascular, neurological, inflammatory, and cognitive health.
  • At-Home Health Test Kits
    Clinically useful tests for vitamin D and omega-3 status, enabling objective baseline assessment and follow-up.

We work closely with accredited laboratories, healthcare professionals, and independent health stores across Ireland. Our emphasis is on quality, traceability, and clinical relevance.

How This Supports Your Practice

  • Continuity of care — patients can continue recommended protocols between consultations.
  • Objective monitoring — testing supports data-informed conversations and progress tracking.
  • Improved adherence — clear products and subscriptions reduce drop-off.
  • Aligned incentives — you earn from responsible recommendations, not volume selling.

This programme is designed to complement — not replace — your clinical judgement.

How Practitioners Earn

Commission Structure

  • Earn 15% commission on qualifying orders placed via your practitioner link or code.
  • Commission is calculated on order value (excluding VAT and shipping).
  • You earn on initial purchases, repeat orders, and subscriptions.
  • 365-day tracking cookies ensure long attribution windows.
  • Payouts are processed monthly via PayPal.

This creates a modest but meaningful revenue stream that reflects the ongoing value of patient education and trust.

What That Can Look Like in Practice

Per-Product Earnings
(Annual, per patient on a consistent protocol)

ProductAvg. Monthly CommissionApprox. Annual Value
Ocean Pure Omega-3~€4.90~€59 per patient / year
Vitamin D3 + K2 + A~€4.00~€48 per patient / year

Illustrative Practice Example

5 patients~€22~€260
20 patients~€90~€1,050
50 patients~€230~€2,700

Figures are indicative and based on steady, responsible recommendations — not aggressive sales.

How to Use This in Your Practice

Patients automatically receive 10% off when ordering via your practitioner link or code.

  • Post-consultation follow-up emails
  • Practice resources or handouts
  • Private patient portals or newsletters
  • Educational content supporting treatment plans

We Provide

  • Clear product information and supporting materials
  • Responsible, compliant wording around health claims
  • Access to assets if you need patient-facing materials

We actively support education-first, clinically responsible use.

Important Notes

  • This programme is intended for qualified health practitioners
  • No coupon sites, cashback platforms, or paid advertising arbitrage
  • All participants are reviewed for professional alignment
  • Please update payment details in Settings → Payment

Questions or specific practice needs? Contact us at {merchant_email}.

If your work centres on long-term patient outcomes, education, and trust, we’re very pleased to work alongside you.

Jon & the Wild Atlantic Health Team

Affiliate Programme – Terms & Conditions

Welcome to Wild Atlantic Health. Thank you for your interest in joining our Affiliate Programme.

These Terms & Conditions (“Terms”) apply to individuals or entities participating in the Wild Atlantic Health Affiliate Programme (“Programme”) as an affiliate (“you”, “your”, or “Affiliate”), and to Wild Atlantic Health Ltd (“we”, “us”, or “Merchant”).

By registering for or participating in the Programme, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree with these Terms in full, you must not participate in the Programme.


1. Approval or Rejection of Affiliate Applications

We reserve the right to approve or reject any Affiliate application at our sole discretion.

There is no obligation on us to provide reasons for approval or rejection, and you will have no legal recourse against us in the event your application is rejected.


2. Affiliate Links and Discount Codes

Once approved, you will be provided with a unique affiliate tracking link. You may also generate affiliate links for specific products or collections via your Affiliate Dashboard.

  • If a customer clicks multiple affiliate links, the last clicked link before purchase will be credited.

  • Affiliates may be assigned a unique discount code at our discretion. Details of any assigned code will be visible in your Affiliate Dashboard.

  • Commission is not doubled if a customer both clicks an affiliate link and uses a discount code.

  • You may only promote discount codes that are explicitly assigned to you. Promoting unauthorised or public codes may result in commission forfeiture or removal from the Programme.

Affiliates may promote Wild Atlantic Health through online channels (including but not limited to websites, blogs, email, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, or YouTube) and offline media (such as print publications), provided such promotion complies with these Terms and all applicable laws.


3. Commission and Payments

Affiliates earn commission on qualifying purchases made through their affiliate link or assigned discount code, in accordance with the commission structure displayed in the Affiliate Dashboard.

  • Commission is calculated on the net order value, excluding VAT, shipping, handling fees, refunds, and other non-product charges.

  • To receive payment, you must provide valid payout details in your Affiliate Dashboard.

  • Payment schedules and minimum payout thresholds are outlined in the Affiliate Guide or Dashboard.

  • Only successfully completed and non-refunded transactions are eligible for commission.

  • We reserve the right to review all referral activity. Transactions that are refunded, cancelled, disputed, or subject to chargebacks will not be paid, and previously paid commissions may be reversed.


4. Marketing Materials

We may provide approved marketing assets (such as banners, logos, images, or promotional copy) via the Affiliate Dashboard.

  • You may use only the materials provided or explicitly approved by Wild Atlantic Health.

  • Materials must not be altered without prior written consent.

  • All marketing must remain accurate, compliant, and aligned with our brand values.


5. Network / Sub-Affiliate Referrals (if enabled)

If the Network feature is enabled in your Affiliate Dashboard, you may invite other affiliates to join the Programme using your unique network referral link.

  • Affiliates who join via your network link may be considered your “downline”.

  • Network commissions, if applicable, are calculated according to the structure defined in your Dashboard.

  • We reserve the right to disable or modify network functionality at any time.


6. Cookie Tracking

Affiliate tracking relies on browser cookies.

  • Cookie duration is displayed at the time of affiliate registration.

  • Tracking begins when a customer clicks your affiliate link or uses your assigned discount code.

  • If cookies are blocked, deleted, or expire, we may be unable to track referrals and no commission will be payable for those orders.

  • Within the cookie period, subsequent qualifying purchases by the same customer may be attributed to you, even if the affiliate link is not clicked again.


7. Acceptable Use and Conduct

Affiliates must:

  • Comply with all applicable advertising, consumer protection, and disclosure laws (including ASA, CMA, FTC, or equivalent guidelines).

  • Clearly disclose affiliate relationships (e.g. using “#ad” or “affiliate link” where required).

  • Avoid misleading, false, or unsubstantiated health claims.

  • Refrain from spam, deceptive practices, or any activity that could harm the Wild Atlantic Health brand.

We reserve the right to suspend or terminate affiliates who breach these standards.


8. Removal from the Affiliate Programme

Either party may terminate participation in the Programme at any time.

  • Affiliates may request removal by contacting info@wildatlantichealth.com.

  • We may suspend or terminate an affiliate account immediately for breach of these Terms, suspected fraud, or misuse of the Programme.

  • Upon termination, any unpaid commissions relating to invalid or refunded transactions will be forfeited.


9. Amendments

We reserve the right to amend these Terms at any time. Updated Terms will be made available on our website or Affiliate Dashboard. Continued participation in the Programme after changes are published constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.


10. Contact

For questions or support relating to the Affiliate Programme, please contact:

📧 info@wildatlantichealth.com



Thank you for being part of the Wild Atlantic Health Affiliate Programme.

We value long-term, transparent partnerships and wish you every success.
